title: TS-73 Host recycled mid-session during a 110 s turn, adding a host start
description: Live rehearsal: host generation 10 to 11 during one long turn, so a 3-start budget was exceeded (4). Find why a host exits or is replaced while a turn is in flight (idle timeout versus activity, lease relinquish TS-61). Scenario first.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Triage 2026-10-14: closing as superseded. The mid-session host recycle was observed on the host-worker path (start generation 10 to 11 during a 110 s turn). Own-account computers no longer use the host worker; the long-lived owner supervisor (computer/host/src/supervisor.ts, Phase 2a, PR 518) only asks to stop for idleness when state is idle with no activity and no child (canAskToStopForIdleness: activity === null, child === null), so a turn in flight cannot hit the idle timeout, and a start for a computer with a live owner is acknowledged, not repeated (features/computer_owner_long_lived.feature: 'A second turn is served by the live owner without a start', 'A turn parked behind a busy owner waits and then runs'). Live proof: README says one owner served two back-to-back turns on development. The customer-account host-worker path keeps its own lease rules; if a recycle during a turn is seen there, open a new ticket with the log lines.

right_now_summary: The issue was superseded; own-account hosts no longer recycle during active turns.
